body.content: Hypothesis: The optimal configuration for 13 points in the unit square involves placing points on a hexagonal-like lattice that has been truncated and squeezed to fit the square, or alternatively, a configuration based on the vertices of a regular 12-gon with one point at the center, all maximally scaled to fit within [0,1]x[0,1]. The minimal triangles would be formed by adjacent vertices of the 12-gon and the center. Area ≈ (pi/12)*sin(30deg) or similar, which could be around 0.04. The square boundary heavily distorts this, however.
